text:
julia: Quick sync — product wants a rollout plan for tenant-priority cohorts for the upcoming model switchover. Need staged regions, A/B quality holdouts, and an eviction ladder for cost spikes. Who can own the runbook?
tanvi: I sketched a proposal: three cohorts — alpha (internal + 5 opt-in customers), beta (20% traffic), gamma (rest). Alpha is per-tenant whitelist, beta via percentage flag.
ryan: Sounds good. For alpha do per-tenant API key whitelisting. For beta we use feature flag `cohort_priority` with rollout percentages. Question: how do we evict if unit-cost or latency spikes?
sam: Proposal for eviction ladder: 1) reduce batch size (auto), 2) switch to quantized model variant (auto), 3) route to cheaper region or dedicated pool (auto), 4) soft-disable noncritical tenants (manual escalation). Each automated step executes with a short cool-down (2m) and a telemetry re-check.
julia: For telemetry gates, let's use: p95 latency > 500ms OR cost/unit > 2.0x baseline sustained for 10m to trigger step 1. Escalate after repeated breaches.
tanvi: Add a quality holdout: A/B with 10% holdback for regression detection. Tie automated alerts to our eval harness and run a small human-rater check if automated metrics cross threshold.
ryan: Who owns the kill-switch (full rollback)? Ops oncall or product? We should allow automated partial fallbacks but manual full rollback.
sam: Ops prefers automated for the first two remediation steps, then require manual approval before tenant soft-disable. I'll draft the runbook with exact thresholds and playbook steps. Also add an API header `X-Model-Variant` for tracing.
deploy-bot: canary started for cohort alpha on region eu-west1 — 2 instances.
julia: Adding a minimal flag config for implementation reference:
```
flag: cohort_priority
variants:
  - alpha: whitelist (5 tenants)
  - beta: pct(20)
  - gamma: default
eviction_policy: ladder
telemetry_gates:
  latency_p95_ms: 500
  cost_ratio: 2.0
  sustained_minutes: 10
```
tanvi: Rollout windows? Prefer off-peak: EU/NA/APAC windows spelled out. Also need per-tenant soft quotas to avoid one tenant dragging the whole cohort.
ryan: Proposed windows: EU 02:00-06:00 UTC, NA 01:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 22:00-02:00 UTC. Per-tenant soft QPS cap = 3x baseline, hard cap configurable.
julia: Action items: Sam -> runbook + escalation playbook; Tanvi -> implement flag + attach eval set + thresholds; Ryan -> telemetry alerts + per-tenant caps in router; I'll draft customer comms and coordinate alpha invite list.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll post a PR with the runbook and a checklist (preflight verifications, smoke queries, abort steps).
tanvi: I'll upload eval-set and sample prompts, wire automated metric checks (BLEU-ish / perplexity / token-level agreement). ETA: EOD Thursday.
ryan: Ops question: do we want automatic fallback to quantized model only if the quality delta < 0.05? Need safe guard so fallback doesn't cause regressions.
julia: Yes — require precomputed regression delta threshold; if unknown, fallback must be manual. Add that to runbook.
deploy-bot: canary health: 1 warning — latency p95 420ms, cost ratio 1.4x, no auto-eviction triggered.
julia: OK keeping this open until runbook + PR land. If no objections by EOD Thursday we trigger alpha next Tue in EU window. Ping here with blockers.
